name: Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid 2
description: During the Clone Wars, a IG-86 sentinel droid was owned by Trandoshan scavenger Gha Nachkt along with two others. When Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano where searching the Vulture's Claw, R3-S6 activated the droid and the other one. After a small battle, both droids were destroyed.
